findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract instantly without cause while you receive no payment for work completed, leaving you entirely unprotected.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery before you have received payment, risking non-payment after the client already owns the intellectual property.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few updates before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause about termination, it allows the agreement to end instantly without notice or payment for completed work; I propose changing this so that either party may terminate for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the client shall pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers upon delivery before payment is received; I propose modifying this so that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment. Thank you for your time and consideration.
